_comment: Cross-language contract for the methodology view defaults (ADR-0041, ADR-1478 §2).
`hiddenByMethodology` is the raw advisory preset: the views a methodology hides by
default. `methodologyNeverHides` lists the views the resolved set keeps visible
regardless (ADR-1298: Plan always offers Schedule), so AGILE resolves to hiding only
web keeps its own copy only for the pre-save methodology flip warning (#3294). Both
copies assert against this file: `METHODOLOGY_HIDDEN_VIEWS` in
